description: This file defines an immutable implementation of the JsonFieldSelector interface, primarily managing a collection of JsonPointer instances and providing related functionalities like creation, accessors, and overrides for equality, hashing, and string representation.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonFieldSelector
classes.description: An immutable class implementing JsonFieldSelector, encapsulating a set of JsonPointer objects and providing methods to create, access, and represent JSON field selectors.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Creates and returns an empty ImmutableJsonFieldSelector instance.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an ImmutableJsonFieldSelector from given JSON pointers, with an optional field selector string.

methods.name: getPointers
methods.description: Returns the set of JsonPointer instances contained in this selector.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of JsonPointer instances in this selector.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the selector contains no pointers.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the JsonPointer elements.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on pointers and string representation.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code based on pointers and the string representation.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the field selector.
